info.title: LedgerCore — SIMULATED financial infrastructure
info.description: Educational double-entry ledger. No real money or payment rails. Amounts are decimal strings in INR or USD. Monetary POSTs require Idempotency-Key; replay preserves status and JSON values.

post.summary: Atomically transfer simulated funds; replay using the original Idempotency-Key
